baseline: published z42 MEDIUM fixed-seed cohort, additional raw military metrics cross-checked

rules.source: founder highest formal personal grant, verified at first resolution
rules.trigger: monthly settlement after actual death; earlier actual deprivation, transfer, accession or authority termination ends the right
rules.heir: registered, living, local direct children by birth month then stable member ID
rules.representation: no representation by grandchildren; no invented heirs
rules.personalNewMerit: independent, no automatic restart or upgrade of the hereditary chain
rules.generalMilitaryBan: does not by itself disqualify inheritance; recorded FORFEITURE has independent title consequence
rules.pardon: qualification to serve does not restore terminated title rights
rules.populationArmyLand: no new entities, troops, offices, merits, appanages or city rights
rules.randomness: no new draws or probability adjustments

duplicateHolderMeaning: one last successful record per chain; prior holders never remain effective, strict replay rejects extra ranks, holders or records

regional-3.note: final same-month authority guards preserve complete canonical fingerprint

regional-7.note: final same-month authority guards preserve complete canonical fingerprint

regional-8.note: regional-8 final text now names the punished holder rather than the entire family; collected title records and compared RNG/gameplay metrics agree, full canonical equality is not claimed for this world

methodology: Initial implementation cohort was not used as final release data after contemporaneous death evidence was strengthened.

Frozen final lifecycle cohort: the same 8 seeds x100; final authority guards and holder-specific narrative rechecked on the three seeds containing all inheritance/invalidation events. These are rechecks, not additional independent samples.
No 200-year extension: three-generation title succession already observed; remaining full five-rank chain tested deterministically, no attempt to force a natural barony or extinction.
Political/war/population/RNG invariance is measured per seed, not inferred from overall averages.
A pedigree with three generations is not three generations of officers or titleholders.
limitations: Only four natural inheritances: not proof of stable long-run rates or all edge cases occurring naturally.
No natural no-heir termination or rank exhaustion; real Core covers no-heir, pure rules cover full degradation.
No new personal-merit renewal in this cohort; original branch-local renewal remains unchanged.
No grandchild representation, parallel hereditary branches, branch restart, title merging, private armies or extra recruitment benefit.

builds.execution: final sequential workspace scripts; prior external dist competition diagnosed without stopping user process

counterSemantics.familyAndTitleTotals: saved unique title transactions and genealogy
counterSemantics.heirCandidatePersonChecks: person checks at committed death resolutions in the full fresh-world session; resets on load
counterSemantics.lifeAndTitleFailures: session counters, reset on load; not stored historical failures
counterSemantics.note: frozen input scope label was broad; canonical counts and session opportunity counters are separated here without changing measured values
